import importlib.util, collections
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689869/attempts/bb90a5c04b7e45689f74d9e2a14a4f73/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):
            if row[c] == bg and row[c - 1] == row[c + 1] and row[c - 1] != bg:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
